$comment: How this app gets its ios/ and android/ folders (expo-prebuild-and-config-plugins). "generated": Continuous Native Generation, the default: npx expo prebuild writes both folders from app.config.ts and its config plugins, they are git-ignored, and nobody edits them. "committed": both folders are source, edited by hand and never regenerated; set it only with a reason and the date the team decided, because app.config.ts native keys and config plugins stop reaching the build.
